relationships.evidence_quote: TMR was superior to RPNI variants and NIM in preventing neuroma formation and alleviating neuropathic pain in this animal model

key_findings: In rat tibial nerve transection, TMR outperformed NIM and RPNI variants in behavioral recovery and prevented gross neuroma formation and collagen fibrosis.
TMR lowered CGRP, TRPA1, TRPV1, NPY, BDNF, c-Fos and pro-inflammatory cytokines in nerve and DRG while raising IL-10, ATP1A2 and ATP2B1.
